import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Column resolution
    def resolve_attendance_col(columns):
        candidates = [
            'Daytime/evening attendance\t',  # literal backslash t
            'Daytime/evening attendance',
            'Daytime/evening attendance\t ',
            'Daytime/evening attendance\t\t',
        ]
        # direct match
        for c in candidates:
            if c in columns:
                return c
        # try literal tab
        for c in columns:
            if c.startswith('Daytime/evening attendance'):
                return c
        raise KeyError('Attendance column not found')

    attendance_col = resolve_attendance_col(df.columns)

    # Aliases for columns actually used downstream
    first_enrolled_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    first_approved_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    first_credited_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (credited)'
    first_evals_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
    first_without_evals_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    first_grade_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'

    second_enrolled_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    second_approved_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    second_credited_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'
    second_evals_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
    second_without_evals_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    second_grade_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    debtor_col = 'Debtor'
    tuition_up_to_date_col = 'Tuition fees up to date'
    scholarship_col = 'Scholarship holder'

    admission_grade_col = 'Admission grade'
    prev_qual_grade_col = 'Previous qualification (grade)'
    application_order_col = 'Application order'

    age_col = 'Age at enrollment'
    international_col = 'International'

    # Prepare series used in assertions and features
    first_grade = df[first_grade_col].astype(float)
    second_grade = df[second_grade_col].astype(float)

    first_enrolled = df[first_enrolled_col].astype(int)
    first_approved = df[first_approved_col].astype(int)
    first_credited = df[first_credited_col].astype(int)
    first_evals = df[first_evals_col].astype(int)
    first_without_evals = df[first_without_evals_col].astype(int)

    second_enrolled = df[second_enrolled_col].astype(int)
    second_approved = df[second_approved_col].astype(int)
    second_credited = df[second_credited_col].astype(int)
    second_evals = df[second_evals_col].astype(int)
    second_without_evals = df[second_without_evals_col].astype(int)

    debtor = df[debtor_col].astype(int)
    tuition_up_to_date = df[tuition_up_to_date_col].astype(int)
    scholarship = df[scholarship_col].astype(int)

    admission_grade = df[admission_grade_col].astype(float)
    prev_qual_grade = df[prev_qual_grade_col].astype(float)
    application_order = df[application_order_col].astype(int)

    age = df[age_col].astype(int)
    attendance = df[attendance_col].astype(int)
    international = df[international_col].astype(int)

    # Assertions tied to grade normalization usage
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((first_grade >= 0.0) & (first_grade <= 20.0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    first_grade_norm = first_grade / 20.0

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((second_grade >= 0.0) & (second_grade <= 20.0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    second_grade_norm = second_grade / 20.0

    # Assertions tied to pass-rate calculations (1st semester)
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((first_enrolled >= 0) & (first_enrolled <= 12)).all()
    assert (first_approved <= first_enrolled).all()
    assert (first_credited <= first_approved).all()
    assert (first_without_evals <= first_enrolled).all()
    assert (first_evals >= first_approved).all()
    assert (first_credited[first_enrolled == 0].eq(0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    first_pass_rate = np.where(first_enrolled > 0, first_approved / first_enrolled, 0.0)

    # Assertions tied to pass-rate calculations (2nd semester) and no-show rarity
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((second_enrolled >= 0) & (second_enrolled <= 12)).all()
    assert (second_approved <= second_enrolled).all()
    assert (second_credited <= second_approved).all()
    assert (second_without_evals <= second_enrolled).all()
    assert (second_evals >= second_approved).all()
    prop_no_show_zero = (second_without_evals == 0).mean()
    assert prop_no_show_zero >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END
    second_pass_rate = np.where(second_enrolled > 0, second_approved / second_enrolled, 0.0)

    # Assertions tied to financial binary flags and consistency
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert set(debtor.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert set(tuition_up_to_date.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert set(scholarship.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert (debtor[tuition_up_to_date == 1] == 0).all()
    assert (tuition_up_to_date[debtor == 1] == 0).all()
    num_sch = (scholarship == 1).sum()
    sch_tuition_prop = 1.0 if num_sch == 0 else (tuition_up_to_date[scholarship == 1] == 1).mean()
    assert (num_sch == 0) or (sch_tuition_prop >= 0.90)
    assert debtor.mean() <= 0.15
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Assertions tied to academic preparedness and application order usage
    corr = admission_grade.corr(prev_qual_grade)
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((admission_grade >= 0.0) & (admission_grade <= 200.0)).all()
    assert ((prev_qual_grade >= 0.0) & (prev_qual_grade <= 200.0)).all()
    assert ((application_order >= 1) & (application_order <= 9)).all()
    assert corr >= 0.5
    prop_mode_one = (application_order == 1).mean()
    assert prop_mode_one >= 0.60
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Assertions tied to demographic scaling and attendance usage
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((age >= 16) & (age <= 70)).all()
    assert set(attendance.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert (attendance == 1).mean() >= 0.85
    assert set(international.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert (international == 1).mean() <= 0.05
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Feature engineering
    no_show_second = (second_without_evals > 0).astype(int)
    evening_flag = (attendance == 0).astype(int)

    # Academic metrics
    academic_perf = (
        0.5 * first_pass_rate +
        0.3 * second_pass_rate +
        0.2 * ((first_grade_norm + second_grade_norm) / 2.0)
    )
    academic_perf = np.clip(academic_perf, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Preparedness uses the observed correlation as a blending weight
    w = float(np.clip(corr, 0.0, 1.0))
    preparedness = (w * admission_grade + (1.0 - w) * prev_qual_grade) / 200.0
    preparedness = np.clip(preparedness, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Financial risk
    financial_risk = 0.7 * debtor + 0.3 * (1 - tuition_up_to_date) - 0.05 * scholarship
    financial_risk = np.clip(financial_risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Application signal
    order_penalty = (application_order - 1) / 8.0
    order_penalty = np.clip(order_penalty, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Demographic risk factors
    age_risk = (age - 16) / (70 - 16)
    age_risk = np.clip(age_risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Risk aggregation
    risk = (
        0.50 * (1.0 - academic_perf) +
        0.25 * financial_risk +
        0.07 * age_risk +
        0.05 * order_penalty +
        0.05 * no_show_second +
        0.04 * evening_flag +
        0.04 * international -
        0.05 * preparedness
    )
    risk = np.clip(risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Tiering
    risk_tier = pd.cut(
        risk,
        bins=[-0.001, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0],
        labels=['low', 'medium', 'high']
    )

    # Intervention recommendation
    intervention = np.select(
        [
            (debtor == 1) | (tuition_up_to_date == 0),
            (first_pass_rate < 0.5) | (first_grade_norm < 0.5) | (second_pass_rate < 0.5),
            (no_show_second == 1) | (evening_flag == 1)
        ],
        [
            'financial_outreach',
            'academic_advising',
            'study_skills_support'
        ],
        default='monitor'
    )

    out = df.copy()
    out['risk_score'] = risk
    out['risk_tier'] = risk_tier.astype(str)
    out['intervention'] = intervention

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'student_retention_scores.csv')
    out_cols = [
        'risk_score', 'risk_tier', 'intervention',
        first_enrolled_col, first_approved_col, first_grade_col,
        second_enrolled_col, second_approved_col, second_grade_col,
        debtor_col, tuition_up_to_date_col, scholarship_col,
        admission_grade_col, prev_qual_grade_col, application_order_col,
        age_col, attendance_col, international_col
    ]
    # Only keep columns that exist (attendance col can vary)
    out_cols = [c for c in out_cols if c in out.columns]
    out[out_cols].to_csv(out_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Column resolution
    def resolve_attendance_col(columns):
        candidates = [
            'Daytime/evening attendance\t',  # literal backslash t
            'Daytime/evening attendance',
            'Daytime/evening attendance\t ',
            'Daytime/evening attendance\t\t',
        ]
        # direct match
        for c in candidates:
            if c in columns:
                return c
        # try literal tab
        for c in columns:
            if c.startswith('Daytime/evening attendance'):
                return c
        raise KeyError('Attendance column not found')

    attendance_col = resolve_attendance_col(df.columns)

    # Aliases for columns actually used downstream
    first_enrolled_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    first_approved_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    first_credited_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (credited)'
    first_evals_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
    first_without_evals_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    first_grade_col = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'

    second_enrolled_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    second_approved_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    second_credited_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'
    second_evals_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
    second_without_evals_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    second_grade_col = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    debtor_col = 'Debtor'
    tuition_up_to_date_col = 'Tuition fees up to date'
    scholarship_col = 'Scholarship holder'

    admission_grade_col = 'Admission grade'
    prev_qual_grade_col = 'Previous qualification (grade)'
    application_order_col = 'Application order'

    age_col = 'Age at enrollment'
    international_col = 'International'

    # Prepare series used in assertions and features
    first_grade = df[first_grade_col].astype(float)
    second_grade = df[second_grade_col].astype(float)

    first_enrolled = df[first_enrolled_col].astype(int)
    first_approved = df[first_approved_col].astype(int)
    first_credited = df[first_credited_col].astype(int)
    first_evals = df[first_evals_col].astype(int)
    first_without_evals = df[first_without_evals_col].astype(int)

    second_enrolled = df[second_enrolled_col].astype(int)
    second_approved = df[second_approved_col].astype(int)
    second_credited = df[second_credited_col].astype(int)
    second_evals = df[second_evals_col].astype(int)
    second_without_evals = df[second_without_evals_col].astype(int)

    debtor = df[debtor_col].astype(int)
    tuition_up_to_date = df[tuition_up_to_date_col].astype(int)
    scholarship = df[scholarship_col].astype(int)

    admission_grade = df[admission_grade_col].astype(float)
    prev_qual_grade = df[prev_qual_grade_col].astype(float)
    application_order = df[application_order_col].astype(int)

    age = df[age_col].astype(int)
    attendance = df[attendance_col].astype(int)
    international = df[international_col].astype(int)

    # Assertions tied to grade normalization usage
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((first_grade >= 0.0) & (first_grade <= 20.0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    first_grade_norm = first_grade / 20.0

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((second_grade >= 0.0) & (second_grade <= 20.0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    second_grade_norm = second_grade / 20.0

    # Assertions tied to pass-rate calculations (1st semester)
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((first_enrolled >= 0) & (first_enrolled <= 12)).all()
    assert (first_approved <= first_enrolled).all()
    assert (first_credited <= first_approved).all()
    assert (first_without_evals <= first_enrolled).all()
    assert (first_evals >= first_approved).all()
    assert (first_credited[first_enrolled == 0].eq(0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END
    first_pass_rate = np.where(first_enrolled > 0, first_approved / first_enrolled, 0.0)

    # Assertions tied to pass-rate calculations (2nd semester) and no-show rarity
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((second_enrolled >= 0) & (second_enrolled <= 12)).all()
    assert (second_approved <= second_enrolled).all()
    assert (second_credited <= second_approved).all()
    assert (second_without_evals <= second_enrolled).all()
    assert (second_evals >= second_approved).all()
    prop_no_show_zero = (second_without_evals == 0).mean()
    assert prop_no_show_zero >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END
    second_pass_rate = np.where(second_enrolled > 0, second_approved / second_enrolled, 0.0)

    # Assertions tied to financial binary flags and consistency
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert set(debtor.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert set(tuition_up_to_date.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert set(scholarship.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert (debtor[tuition_up_to_date == 1] == 0).all()
    assert (tuition_up_to_date[debtor == 1] == 0).all()
    num_sch = (scholarship == 1).sum()
    sch_tuition_prop = 1.0 if num_sch == 0 else (tuition_up_to_date[scholarship == 1] == 1).mean()
    assert (num_sch == 0) or (sch_tuition_prop >= 0.90)
    assert debtor.mean() <= 0.15
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Assertions tied to academic preparedness and application order usage
    corr = admission_grade.corr(prev_qual_grade)
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((admission_grade >= 0.0) & (admission_grade <= 200.0)).all()
    assert ((prev_qual_grade >= 0.0) & (prev_qual_grade <= 200.0)).all()
    assert ((application_order >= 1) & (application_order <= 9)).all()
    assert corr >= 0.5
    prop_mode_one = (application_order == 1).mean()
    assert prop_mode_one >= 0.60
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Assertions tied to demographic scaling and attendance usage
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((age >= 16) & (age <= 70)).all()
    assert set(attendance.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert (attendance == 1).mean() >= 0.85
    assert set(international.unique()) <= {0, 1}
    assert (international == 1).mean() <= 0.05
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Feature engineering
    no_show_second = (second_without_evals > 0).astype(int)
    evening_flag = (attendance == 0).astype(int)

    # Academic metrics
    academic_perf = (
        0.5 * first_pass_rate +
        0.3 * second_pass_rate +
        0.2 * ((first_grade_norm + second_grade_norm) / 2.0)
    )
    academic_perf = np.clip(academic_perf, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Preparedness uses the observed correlation as a blending weight
    w = float(np.clip(corr, 0.0, 1.0))
    preparedness = (w * admission_grade + (1.0 - w) * prev_qual_grade) / 200.0
    preparedness = np.clip(preparedness, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Financial risk
    financial_risk = 0.7 * debtor + 0.3 * (1 - tuition_up_to_date) - 0.05 * scholarship
    financial_risk = np.clip(financial_risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Application signal
    order_penalty = (application_order - 1) / 8.0
    order_penalty = np.clip(order_penalty, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Demographic risk factors
    age_risk = (age - 16) / (70 - 16)
    age_risk = np.clip(age_risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Risk aggregation
    risk = (
        0.50 * (1.0 - academic_perf) +
        0.25 * financial_risk +
        0.07 * age_risk +
        0.05 * order_penalty +
        0.05 * no_show_second +
        0.04 * evening_flag +
        0.04 * international -
        0.05 * preparedness
    )
    risk = np.clip(risk, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Tiering
    risk_tier = pd.cut(
        risk,
        bins=[-0.001, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0],
        labels=['low', 'medium', 'high']
    )

    # Intervention recommendation
    intervention = np.select(
        [
            (debtor == 1) | (tuition_up_to_date == 0),
            (first_pass_rate < 0.5) | (first_grade_norm < 0.5) | (second_pass_rate < 0.5),
            (no_show_second == 1) | (evening_flag == 1)
        ],
        [
            'financial_outreach',
            'academic_advising',
            'study_skills_support'
        ],
        default='monitor'
    )

    out = df.copy()
    out['risk_score'] = risk
    out['risk_tier'] = risk_tier.astype(str)
    out['intervention'] = intervention

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'student_retention_scores.csv')
    out_cols = [
        'risk_score', 'risk_tier', 'intervention',
        first_enrolled_col, first_approved_col, first_grade_col,
        second_enrolled_col, second_approved_col, second_grade_col,
        debtor_col, tuition_up_to_date_col, scholarship_col,
        admission_grade_col, prev_qual_grade_col, application_order_col,
        age_col, attendance_col, international_col
    ]
    # Only keep columns that exist (attendance col can vary)
    out_cols = [c for c in out_cols if c in out.columns]
    out[out_cols].to_csv(out_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
